description: This is a Java test source file for integration tests related to Loan Interest Refund functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It contains multiple test cases verifying different refund scenarios, including interest refund creation, transaction verification, amortization, and multiple disbursement/refund patterns.

classes.name: LoanInterestRefundTest
classes.description: JUnit test class containing multiple test cases for verifying interest refund functionalities on loans, including different refund types and scenarios in the Apache Fineract project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured setup and creates a client before all tests.
